metadata.description: Reviewed Claude Code plugins for SRE and DevSecOps work

plugins.name: sre-engineering
plugins.description: Google SRE practice from the SRE Book and SRE Workbook: SLOs and error budget policy, monitoring and burn-rate alerting, on-call, incident response, postmortems, toil, releases and canarying, overload protection, capacity and launch reviews

plugins.name: sdlc-team
plugins.description: A virtual software team of subagents (PO, BA, architect, developer, security, QA, QE, QC, SRE) that takes a task, user story, incident or CVE through Scrum-style refinement, planning, implementation, testing, monitoring and acceptance
